meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Azure CLI 的 az quota 命令,查某个订阅、资源提供方和区域下的配额上限、当前用量与剩余可用量,并能在部署前校验容量、比较各区域可用配额、提交配额提升申请。
howto.when: 当你准备规划部署、校验容量或挑选区域,或提到“检查配额”“超出配额”“vCPU 上限”等关键词时会触发。

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 的可用配额,哪个更适合部署
say.note: 按你指定的区域逐项比较限额与余量

howto.what_en: Claude uses Azure CLI (az quota) to look up Azure service limits, current usage and remaining capacity per resource provider and region. It validates capacity before deployment, compares quotas across regions, and can submit quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan a deployment, validate capacity or pick a region, or mention “check quotas”, “quota exceeded”, “vCPU limit” and similar.

say_en.text: Check the vCPU quota and remaining capacity for Microsoft.Compute in eastus
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage and available capacity

say_en.text: Compare available quota in eastus and westus2 — which fits my deployment
say_en.note: Compares limits across the regions you name

say_en.text: My standardDSv3Family quota in eastus is low; request an increase to 500
say_en.note: Submits the request and shows its status
